module: Manages facilities (drag installations) in the drag race editor: list loaded via gameplay_drag_saveSystem, selection, creation, deletion, saving as <id>.facility.json in the level's dragstrips folder (with file renaming if the id changes), and ImGui panels (list, details, adding/removing strips). A facility groups strip file paths (stripIds).
notes: Each facility has internal editing fields: _filePath (file path) and _dirty (modified, unsaved).
selectFacility deselects strip and settings and writes into the current settings facilityId = "/levels/<level>/dragstrips/<id>.facility.json" (or the id alone without a level).
In the list, facility.stripIds is assumed non-nil; the detail creates it if missing.
drawFacilitiesPreview only writes the facility name at the origin (0,0,0).

loadAllFacilities.desc: Loads all facilities with dragSaveSystem.getAllFacilities(), resets _dirty to false and fills in _filePath from the level's drag folder.

hasSavedFacilities.desc: Indicates whether at least one facility has a file and is not modified.

getSelectedFacilityIndex.desc: Index (1-based) of the selected facility, -1 if none.

setSelectedFacilityIndex.desc: Sets the selected index without side effects.

selectFacility.desc: Selects a facility: leaves zone editing, deselects strip and settings, puts facilityId in the current drag settings and marks unsaved changes.

addFacility.desc: Creates a "New Facility" facility (id new_facility_N, empty stripIds, _dirty=true), adds it and selects it.

removeSelectedFacility.desc: Removes the selected facility from the list (the file on disk is not deleted) and adjusts the selection.

saveAllFacilities.desc: Saves all modified facilities in the level's drag folder, creating it if needed.

returns.desc: false if there is no level or the folder cannot be created, otherwise true (even if an individual save failed)

saveFacility.desc: Saves a facility to <level>/<id>.facility.json. If the id changed, first renames the old file (fails if the new one already exists).

drawFacilitiesList.desc: Draws the ImGui list with Add, Remove, Save, Refresh buttons; unsaved entries are shown in orange.

drawFacilityDetails.desc: Draws the editing UI for the selected facility: id, name, description, adding (dropdown with search) and removing strips.

drawFacilitiesPreview.desc: Draws the name of the selected facility at the origin as 3D debug.
